title: Degraded availability for GPT-6 Luna in Copilot
summary: On November 19, 2026, between 15:38 and 16:18 UTC, GitHub Copilot requests using the GPT-6 Luna model experienced degraded availability. During this time, an average of 45% of GPT-6 Luna requests failed, peaking at 63%. Copilot Fusion Max was also temporarily unavailable during this incident. timeline.body: On November 19, 2026, between 15:38 and 16:18 UTC, GitHub Copilot requests using the GPT-6 Luna model experienced degraded availability. During this time, an average of 45% of GPT-6 Luna requests failed, peaking at 63%. Copilot Fusion Max was also temporarily unavailable during this incident. Users could continue using Copilot by selecting a different model. The degradation was caused by an issue with an upstream model provider. GitHub engineers detected the issue through automated monitoring, worked with the provider to resolve it, and restored full service.
